pricing.basis: OpenAI's published Standard text-token rate for gpt-6-sol as recorded for the 2026-10-27 MSNL campaign (docs/benchmarks/evidence/msnl_mechanism_content_v1/preflight_01_report.json) and corroborated on 2026-10-30 by third-party price listings; OpenAI's own pages cannot be fetched from this environment, so the rate is not independently inspected. No proxy charge is documented. The calculated cost is not an invoice; reasoning tokens are counted inside output tokens once.

reservation.rule: Before each request, reserve (UTF-8 bytes of the whole request body + 1000) input tokens and max_output_tokens output tokens at the reservation rates; a token covers at least one byte, and 6x the published rate is above every higher-tier multiplier reported for the model. A request is sent only if the committed bound plus its reservation is at most the ceiling. After it, the bound grows by its validated usage at the reservation rates, or by its whole reservation when usage is unavailable or the attempt failed.
